paragraphs: Ravin. I wrote all of them under aleph, Avin. [Glosses: Ravin. (1) Yoma 42a: Ravya bar Kisi; Hullin 20b: Ravin bar Kisa; Bava Batra 63a: Ravina bar Kisi. Not corrected [ל״ת, provisionally “not corrected”, here and below]; which is right needs examination. (2) Pesahim 34, beginning of a: Ravin bar Aha said that R' Yitzhak said. It seems to me it should read bar Rav Adda; not corrected. (3) Hullin 75b: Ravin bar Hanina; most places have Hinena. Not corrected.]
